headlines.text: 2021 brought us this moment: Christian Cage competed under the AEW banner for the first time against Frankie Kazarian, appearing on Dynamite, rated 7.19 ? a good, competitive contest. One of the most highly anticipated debuts in AEW's early history ? Cage returning to the ring for the first time in seven years, having been kept a closely guarded surprise signing since his shocking Royal Rumble return just months earlier.

That Wednesday in 2021, Kenny Omega chalked up their 50th recorded AEW match ? a genuine milestone, facing Good Brothers & Omega vs. Lucha Brothers & Laredo Kid on Dynamite, rated 7.62 ? a well-paced, entertaining battle in a chaotic six-man affair.

Rewind to 2021, when Cassidy & Taylor vs. Miro & Sabian settled things in an Arcade Anarchy Tag match on Dynamite, rated 8.09 ? one of the better matches of the year in a back-and-forth tag team affair.

secondaries.text: Flash back to 2021, when after 2 matches, Allie debuted a bold new identity: The Bunny, on Dynamite.
It was 2021 when it marked the first-ever meeting between Jon Moxley and Cezar Bononi on Dynamite, rated 4.20.
2021 brought us this moment: it was the first-ever encounter between Cody Rhodes and QT Marshall in an Exhibition Match on Dynamite, rated 4.07.
